continuation.qualification: Byte-identical copy of existing checkpoint and prefix; original run preserved. Exact archived implementation and same numerical environment; no physics or input changes. Historical interrupt failure remains recorded in parent summary.

average.interpretation: transient short-window mean; startup may be included

summary.observed_passages_reason: pressure events are reported by plotting; detonation passages require field inspection
summary.torque_reason: whole-run mean, mean-radius wall model; unvalidated coefficients; see saved heat-exchange settings

window.operator: native integrals prorated within partial steps; inventory linearly interpolated between accepted states; other samples use step-end rectangles
window.qualification: partial-step closure checks this interpolation, not an independently evolved state

budgets.scale_definition: inventory/transport scale with sqrt(mass * total energy) momentum reference

exit_numerical_force.definition: top-face numerical axial momentum flux minus ambient pressure times exit area

exit_cell_force_estimate.definition: step-end cell-centre estimate; rectangle-rule time average, not the RK numerical face flux

annulus_exit_effective_isp.definition: annulus-exit effective Isp: exit impulse / (net injected mass in same window * g0); not whole-engine Isp

pressure_stations.definition: step-end circumferential means, weighted by interval overlap

chemical_conversion.definition: q times reacted-mass source; internal conversion, not an extra total-energy source

engine_torque.definition: reaction torque on engine = negative native wall momentum source times mean radius
engine_torque.qualification: constant-Cf closure, unvalidated; mean-radius approximation; see radial assumptions for heat exchange; no vehicle stability claim

radial_wall_exchange.qualification: actual-radius traction reconstruction; solver angular inventory uses mean radius, so these moments are not interchangeable

window.physical_validation: not established by this report; transient window, no steady-state or sustained-detonation classification

interpretation: Pressure candidates are not detonation detections. Tracks break at ambiguities/dropouts. Nearby reaction windows alone do not validate coupling. Original 40 us prefix and source/environment preserved; no physics change.
